correctness.rationale: Exact hub-status decomposition gives the claimed polynomial; the rational path transfer R_(m+1)=1/(1+z R_m) preserves the positive-real and magnitude domain on Re z>=0. Uniform estimates Re[z/(1+z)^a]>-1/3 and |z/(1+z)^a|<=1/2 establish Re normalized I>1/12. Every denominator is zero-free on Re z>=0. Adjacent hubs are separate and have margin >1/3. Independently enumerated graph subsets and exact Routh-Hurwitz signs agree for all 96 bounded triples (a,b from 2..5, d from 1..6); finite checks corroborate, not replace, proof.

value.rationale: The cited foundational research poses classification of stable trees; the 2026 natural next step handles only one branching vertex. This exact two-branch all-parameter theorem, with arbitrary joining-path length and unbounded leaf counts, provides a genuinely structural positive family and a uniform analytic certificate rather than a coefficient recomputation, small-instance table, or renaming.
